explanation: Brennan's conjecture in integral-means form: B(−2) = 1, where B(τ) is the sup over normalized univalent f of the integral means spectrum limsup log ∫|f'(re^{iθ})|^τ dθ / |log(1−r)|. For τ = −2 the ratio is bounded by Koebe distortion, so the real limsup is meaningful. The equivalence with Brennan's original L^p statement is standard (Pommerenke). The statement is well formed. The solved status rests on the September 2026 OpenAI result with a linked Lean proof, which I did not verify.
